method: Independent read of original Unity YAML and source Prefab root defaults; apply root-target overrides and all scene parent local TRS. File IDs remain strings. No parser or assembled-scene output was used to compute these transforms.

coordinate_conversion.name: Unity left-handed to glTF right-handed by flip X
coordinate_conversion.quaternion_policy: Normalize source quaternions before composing TRS.
coordinate_conversion.matrix_storage: Explicit row-major and glTF column-major arrays are named separately.
coordinate_conversion.runtime_contract: The checker reads H from each layout.coordinate_contract and derives expected glTF matrices from unchanged Unity matrices.

comparison_contract.node_anchor: extras.source_instance_id matches the source instance and extras.source_is_prefab_root is true; use that source root before FBX mesh-unit adapters.

scenes.source_counts_note: Raw source-document instance counts, not LOD-expanded visible mesh counts; FX and global settings are recorded separately.

camera.matrix_note: Object basis conversion only; adapt Unity local +Z camera/light forward to the glTF camera/light local -Z convention separately. Unity forward/up vectors are the source authority.

directional_light.matrix_note: Object basis conversion only; adapt Unity local +Z camera/light forward to the glTF camera/light local -Z convention separately. Unity forward/up vectors are the source authority.
